And he is proving to the basketball world that he is easily a top 50 player in the NBA.

When the Thunder won the championship last season, Mitchell literally took zero rest, immediately suiting up to hoop in the Summer League just weeks later.

That relentless work ethic is paying off in a major way.

With Jalen Williams dealing with injuries this year, Mitchell has stepped up and completely made a name for himself.

What makes his rise even more insane is his contract situation.

Ajay Mitchell signing a 3-year, $9 million deal must be the best value contract in the NBA today.

He is making $2.8 million next season with only $1.5 million guaranteed, and the 2027-28 season is just a $2.8 million team option.

His next contract is going to be incredibly lucrative, but for now, it is safe to say Sam Presti has done it again 💰
